data.turoyo: Izǧioġlu. Əmmiwole "Izǧioġlu", albay we. Fayəšwo b Məḏyaḏ ġalabe, omər: "Tüm Midyatlilar, kefaletimle, dişari çikin. Istediǧiniz yere gidebilirsiniz. Kefiliniz benim. Hepinize ben kefilim. Yarin öǧleye kadar, kefaltimle istediǧiniz yere gidip gezebilirsiniz. (Am məḏyoye kulle, taḥt i kafalayḏi, nfaqu larwal. Li dəkṯo, d əbʕitu, zoxu. U kfilaṯxu d kulayxu əno no. Hul ramḥəl falge d yawmo taḥt i kafalayḏi, l ayko d əbʕitu zoxu kraxu)."
data.translation: İzcioğlu. They used to call him “İzcioğlu”; he was a colonel. He had stayed in Midyat a long time. He says in Turkish, “All Midyat people, come outside on my guarantee. You may go wherever you want. I am your guarantor. I stand surety for you all. Until noon tomorrow, on my guarantee, you may go and walk wherever you want.” The Turoyo explanation repeats: “All the Midyat people, under my guarantee, come outside. Go to the place you want. I am the guarantor for all of you. Until noon tomorrow, under my guarantee, go and walk wherever you want.”

data.turoyo: Bəṯr məd makraxxe ʕaynayye ʕal i kaččəke, ḥəzyulle, gəzzən ʕala l uṣul, gḥayra aʕla, iḏa aṯi w mʕaǧbulle, gdəmmənne: "Ašər rḥəmanxu, kubʕena hatu ste d ruḥmitullan."
data.translation: Nachdem sie sich nach einem Mädchen umgeschaut haben und es gefunden haben, dann folgen sie der Tradition. Sie sehen sich (das Mädchen genauer) an, und wenn es ihnen gefällt, sagen sie (zu den Eltern): Wir haben euch liebgewonnen, und wir möchten, dass auch ihr uns liebgewinnt.

rationale: New collocation; explicit eyes object and prospective bride target.

summary: Physical circulation extends to venom, dust, eyes and a moving ship; information circulates in the existing songs/talk examples. These participant changes do not each require a numbered sense.
The topic construction i čiroke kokərxo aʕl is already represented at 73/12. Zero-marked place/route complements occur alongside b- and ʕal-; preserve the gloss and record government variation.
Search permits an omitted goal, ʕal-, bəṯr- and possibly b-; bride seeking is search, whereas the inherited second sense 5 denotes dating.

Moving rennet in milk, spreading ḥawdal over a cloth, rotating a millstone, setting mills in motion and carrying a shoe round for fitting retain caused motion. The manufacturing/fitting purpose does not establish a separate lexical operation.

Eyes collocation includes visual surveying without a bride target (112/230), alongside directed search in JTM 1.3; movement of writing reed over paper is a physical implement extension, not an independently established write sense.
Book as causer and topics as a nonspatial domain extend leading around; an implicit reader is plausible, not an expressed causee.
Dangat are used after boiled wheat dries and is pounded. Retain caused motion, as in the round-1 millstone example; do not equate this operation with threshing harvested grain.

Oral stories circulate and crop sap spreads in ears; these continue round-1 circulation extensions. Drum procession and rail service also retain movement, with participant identity sometimes uncertain.
Refuge in a monastery is compatible with inherited refuge-taking, with tamo instead of gab-person.
